text:
rachel: opened PR to fix API reference for POST /v1/generate. found a couple of small but breaking mismatches while validating the JavaScript SDK and a few backend clients.

rachel: issues I hit while running smoke tests:
- `logit_bias` parameter is documented as `object` with `integer` values (token->int) but runtime accepts floats (bias weights can be fractional). docs example uses "50256": 1 which accidentally clamps to ints in some generated clients.
- the reference response examples don't show the new optional field `deterministic_score` (float between 0 and 1) which we attach for A/B and rollout analysis. Some data pipelines expect it.
- one of the cURL examples in docs/reference/generate.md omits `-d` and fails in our markdown-driven CI snippet tests.

diego: good catches. can you paste the broken snippets so i can patch openapi.yaml and the examples?

rachel: current (incorrect) param snippet in openapi.yaml:
```yaml
parameters:
  logit_bias:
    type: object
    additionalProperties:
      type: integer
    description: "Map from token id to bias integer"
```
should be:
```yaml
parameters:
  logit_bias:
    type: object
    additionalProperties:
      type: number
      format: float
    description: "Map from token id (string) to bias weight (float). Positive => increase, negative => decrease."
```

rachel: and response example runtime now emits (added to PR examples):
```json
{
  "id": "r-zz99",
  "choices": [{"text": "Done"}],
  "tokens": 13,
  "deterministic_score": 0.87
}
```
Docs previously omitted deterministic_score.

doc-ci: openapi-check: found a missing `-d` in docs/reference/generate.md code block line 18 (curl snippet) and an OpenAPI type mismatch for logit_bias (integer vs number).

mia: i'll update openapi.yaml to make additionalProperties: {type: number, format: float} and add deterministic_score: {type: number, minimum: 0.0, maximum: 1.0} to the 200 response schema. Also update the generated TS types.

diego: please add a tiny example in the API reference showing how clients should interpret deterministic_score (e.g., treat close to 1 as high confidence) and a one-liner showing logit_bias with float values so examples render decimals: `{"50256": -1.5, "345": 0.25}`.

rachel: added example snippet and fixed the curl `-d` issue in the PR. Also added a short migration note under docs/migration/v1.7.md: "logit_bias now accepts float values; regenerate typed clients".

doc-ci: Re-run checks... All checks passed ✅ (lint, openapi-check, snippets).

diego: LGTM from eng. small nit: mention that token keys remain strings in the map to avoid generators converting them to numbers.

mia: updated wording: clarified keys are string token ids. pushed.

sam: approving from docs. i'll kick off a client regen for JS/TS. thanks for catching the curl snippet — that was causing the broken live example.

rachel: merged. I'll follow up with another PR to propagate the deterministic_score explanation into the analytics guide and add a short test in the JS SDK verifying float logit_bias round-trips.

doc-ci: notification: merge complete.
